about.title: PetPulse's Mission
about.desc: PetPulse was born with the belief that every pet deserves comprehensive and scientific health care. We digitize health records and integrate AI technology to make tracking and caring for pets easier than ever.

points.2: Commitment to accompany your pet's life

free.a: Yes! You can start with the forever free plan, managing up to 3 pets. When you need to unlock all features, you can upgrade to Premium anytime.

multiplePets.a: Yes. The Free plan allows up to 3 pets. If you have more, the Premium plan supports unlimited pets, along with advanced features like AI Symptom Checker.

aiAccuracy.q: Is the AI Symptom Checker accurate?
aiAccuracy.a: The AI uses large language models to analyze symptoms based on veterinary databases. Results are for reference only and do not replace a vet's diagnosis.

security.a: Absolutely. We apply top-tier security standards: end-to-end encryption, multi-factor authentication, and compliance with privacy regulations.

cancel.a: Yes. You can cancel Premium anytime without additional fees. Benefits will remain until the end of the current billing cycle.

supportedPets.a: We support Dogs, Cats, Birds, Fish, Hamsters, and many other common pets.
